# Sleeping (font)
- Author: Darrell Flood. Source: https://www.creativefabrica.com/product/sleeping/ref/74273/
- Licence: free for personal use; commercial use needs a paid licence (see LICENSE.txt). Course project (non-commercial); buy a licence before any commercial release.
- Lacks Vietnamese diacritics (134 of 138 test glyphs missing): UiFactory falls back to Arial/Segoe UI for them.
- `Assets/_Project/Art/UI/Resources/Fonts/Sleeping.ttf` is a copy so `Resources.Load` can reach it.
